бути: to exist; e.g. I am, you are
говорити, розмовляти (мовою): to talk; to use a language
дивитися: to turn your eyes towards something; to watch
допомагати: to make things easier for someone
жити: to have your home in a place
знати: to have information in your head
писати: to put words on paper or a screen
пити: to take a liquid into your mouth
подобатися; любити: to think something is nice; to enjoy
потребувати; бути потрібним: to require; to want something you must have
працювати: to have a job; to do your job
приходити; приїжджати: to move towards here; to arrive
робити, готувати: to create; to cook (e.g. a meal)
спати: to rest with your eyes closed at night
читати: to look at words and understand them
іти; їхати: to move to another place; to walk or travel
їсти: to put food in your mouth and swallow it
